mapper.select: select r.erc_id as recordId, r.erc_schedule_id as scheduleId, r.erc_candidate_id as talId, r.erc_status as status, r.erc_sub_camera_token as subToken, date_format(r.erc_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, s.esd_paper_id as paperId, s.esd_position_id as positionId, s.esd_end_at as endAtRaw, s.esd_force_dual_camera as forceDualCamera, p.epa_name as paperName, p.epa_duration_min as durationMin, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, pos.pos_company_id as companyId, u.nick_name as candidateName from t_exam_record r join t_exam_schedule s on s.esd_id = r.erc_schedule_id join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = r.erc_candidate_id and t.tal_user_id = #{userId} join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where r.erc_id = #{recordId}

select r.erc_id as recordId, r.erc_schedule_id as scheduleId, r.erc_candidate_id as talId, r.erc_status as status, r.erc_sub_camera_token as subToken, date_format(r.erc_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, p.epa_name as paperName, p.epa_duration_min as durationMin, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, pos.pos_company_id as companyId, u.nick_name as candidateName from t_exam_record r join t_exam_schedule s on s.esd_id = r.erc_schedule_id join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = r.erc_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where r.erc_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_exam_monitor (emt_record_id) select #{recordId} from dual where not exists (select 1 from t_exam_monitor where emt_record_id = #{recordId})
mapper.select: select emt_sub_status as subStatus, date_format(emt_sub_join_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as subJoinAt, date_format(emt_last_heartbeat_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastHeartbeatAt from t_exam_monitor where emt_record_id = #{recordId} limit 1
mapper.update: update t_exam_monitor set emt_sub_status = 1, emt_sub_join_at = coalesce(emt_sub_join_at, now()), emt_last_heartbeat_at = now() where emt_record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select: select r.erc_id as recordId, r.erc_schedule_id as scheduleId, u.nick_name as candidateName, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, p.epa_name as paperName, date_format(r.erc_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, date_format(least(date_add(r.erc_start_at, interval p.epa_duration_min minute), s.esd_end_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as deadlineAt, s.esd_force_dual_camera as forceDualCamera, m.emt_sub_status as subStatus, date_format(m.emt_last_heartbeat_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as subHeartbeatAt from t_exam_record r join t_exam_schedule s on s.esd_id = r.erc_schedule_id join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = r.erc_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_exam_monitor m on m.emt_record_id = r.erc_id where r.erc_status = 1 and pos.pos_company_id = #{companyId} order by r.erc_start_at desc
